metadata.authority: MITRE D3FEND™ Knowledge Base (Defensive Tactics and Techniques for Cybersecurity)
metadata.description: Authoritative mapping catalog linking MITRE ATT&CK techniques through documented ATT&CK mitigations to verified MITRE D3FEND defensive countermeasures.

countermeasure.name: Executable Allowlisting
countermeasure.definition: Specifying authorized binaries or software signatures that are permitted to execute on a computer system, blocking non-allowlisted interpreters or scripts.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1038 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-EAL)
mappings.rationale: Enforcing application allowlisting policies (AppLocker, WDAC) restricts unauthorized execution of PowerShell scripts and interpreters.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires central policy enforcement (e.g. AppLocker, Intune, or GPO) with maintainable digital signature rules.

countermeasure.name: Process Segment Execution Prevention
countermeasure.definition: Configuring memory page permissions (W^X / DEP) so that memory segments designated for data storage cannot be executed as instructions.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1038 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-PSEP)
mappings.rationale: Hardware-enforced Data Execution Prevention (DEP) stops memory injection and buffer overflow shellcode staging from executing in script runtimes.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires processor support (NX/XD bit) and operating system kernel enforcement.

mappings.mitigation_name: Disable or Remove Feature or Program

countermeasure.name: Application Configuration Hardening
countermeasure.definition: Configuring application features, options, and security settings to minimize attack surface and disable unneeded functionality.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1042 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-ACH)
mappings.rationale: Disabling PowerShell or configuring PowerShell Constrained Language Mode (CLM) restricts available API types and language elements, preventing malicious script execution.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires policy enforcement across endpoints (e.g. AppLocker/WDAC enforcement mode for CLM) without breaking required administrative scripts.

countermeasure.name: Local Account Monitoring
countermeasure.definition: Auditing and monitoring local user and administrator accounts on an endpoint for unauthorized usage, privilege escalation, or membership changes.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1026 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-LAM)
mappings.rationale: Restricting and monitoring local administrative privileges limits the blast radius of scripts attempting local privilege escalation.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires central security event aggregation (Windows Event ID 4720, 4728, 4732) into a SIEM.

countermeasure.name: Executable Allowlisting
countermeasure.definition: Specifying authorized binaries or software signatures that are permitted to execute on a computer system, blocking non-allowlisted interpreters or scripts.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1038 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-EAL)
mappings.rationale: Preventing unauthorized script engines (cscript, wscript, mshta) from executing limits attacker interpreter choices.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires maintenance of allowlists and policy enforcement across Linux/Windows hosts.

countermeasure.name: System File Analysis
countermeasure.definition: Inspecting system and application executable files, scripts, and logs on a host to identify anomalous patterns or unauthorized modifications.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1047 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-SFA)
mappings.rationale: System file auditing captures script executions, command-line arguments, and batch script invocations across hosts.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires host audit log forwarding (Sysmon, auditd, or Event ID 4688 with command lines).

countermeasure.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
countermeasure.definition: Requiring multiple independent authentication factors (knowledge, possession, inherence) prior to granting session authorization.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1032 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-MFA)
mappings.rationale: Compromised credentials cannot authenticate to protected services if an out-of-band second factor is mandated.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires identity provider (IdP) integration across external gateways, VPNs, and internal administrative portals.

countermeasure.name: User Account Permissions
countermeasure.definition: Configuring user account privileges and group memberships to enforce least privilege and limit administrative access.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1015 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-UAP)
mappings.rationale: Restricting active directory permissions and tiering administrative accounts prevents adversaries from pivoting with standard user accounts.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires Active Directory / Entra ID role-based access control architecture and periodic access audits.

countermeasure.name: Local File Permissions
countermeasure.definition: Setting discretionary access control lists (DACLs) and file ownership on local storage to restrict read, write, and execute permissions.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1018 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-LFP)
mappings.rationale: Restricting filesystem permissions on local workstations and servers prevents valid non-admin accounts from accessing sensitive data stores.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires consistent DACL configuration across filesystem shares and server volumes.

countermeasure.name: Strong Password Policy
countermeasure.definition: Enforcing complexity, length, rotation, and non-reuse criteria for user and service passwords to prevent brute-force and credential reuse attacks.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1026 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-SPP)
mappings.rationale: High-entropy, un-guessable credentials reduce likelihood of valid account compromise through password spraying or rainbow tables.
mappings.environment_limitations: Enforced via fine-grained password policies in Active Directory or identity provider.

countermeasure.name: Authorization Event Thresholding
countermeasure.definition: Tracking and enforcing thresholds on system-level authorization and privilege requests to detect abnormal privilege manipulation sequences.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1040 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-AZET)
mappings.rationale: Process injection primitives frequently involve cross-process authorization tokens (SeDebugPrivilege, PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS) detectable via privilege thresholding.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires endpoint security sensor monitoring Windows access tokens and handle creation.

countermeasure.name: Inferred Memory Protection
countermeasure.definition: Application-inferred conceptual defense: encrypting runtime process memory regions or using hardware-enforced memory isolation to protect against unauthorized cross-process memory manipulation.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Application-defined heuristic inference (no direct MITRE D3FEND ontology countermeasure or M1040 table mapping)
mappings.rationale: Heuristic defense against VirtualAllocEx/WriteProcessMemory injection; categorized under app namespace because MITRE D3FEND does not publish a native ProcessMemoryEncryption countermeasure.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires specialized runtime hypervisor or hardware memory encryption extensions (e.g. Intel SGX, AMD SEV).

countermeasure.name: Software Update
countermeasure.definition: Systematically applying vendor security patches and software revisions to remediate known code vulnerabilities.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1051 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-SU)
mappings.rationale: Applying security updates addresses vulnerabilities (e.g. CVE-2021-44228, CVE-2023-46805) directly at the software code level.
mappings.environment_limitations: Subject to operational testing and maintenance release schedules.

countermeasure.name: Hardware-based Process Isolation
countermeasure.definition: Using hardware virtualization features (e.g. hypervisors, enclaves, or virtualization-based security) to isolate process execution environments.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1048 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-HBPI)
mappings.rationale: Isolating public-facing web servers in sandboxed virtual containers prevents compromised application processes from breaking out to the host.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires virtualization-capable host infrastructure and containerization platforms.

countermeasure.name: System Call Filtering
countermeasure.definition: Restricting the system calls that a running process can make to the operating system kernel (e.g. seccomp-bpf).

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1048 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-SCF)
mappings.rationale: Restricting allowed kernel syscalls prevents an exploited public application from executing arbitrary shells or spawns.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires kernel syscall filtering framework support (e.g. Linux seccomp profiles or Windows process mitigation policies).

countermeasure.name: Hardware-based Process Isolation
countermeasure.definition: Using hardware virtualization features (e.g. hypervisors, enclaves, or virtualization-based security) to isolate credential processes and memory.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1043 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-HBPI)
mappings.rationale: Isolating credential storage using Virtualization-based Security (Credential Guard) prevents Mimikatz from reading LSASS plaintext secrets.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires UEFI Secure Boot and hardware virtualization support enabled in firmware.

countermeasure.name: Network Isolation
countermeasure.definition: Enforcing physical or logical separation between network segments or endpoints to restrict communications.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1037 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-NI)
mappings.rationale: Isolating network segments and filtering upstream traffic prevents denial-of-service packet flooding from saturating internal application tiers.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires managed network perimeter switches or upstream ISP scrubbing support.

mappings.mitigation_name: Disable or Remove Feature or Program

countermeasure.name: Application Configuration Hardening
countermeasure.definition: Configuring application features, options, and security settings to minimize attack surface and disable unneeded functionality.

mappings.mapping_provenance: Official MITRE ATT&CK Mitigation M1042 to D3FEND Technique Mapping (D3-ACH)
mappings.rationale: Disabling or removing unnecessary web server features, modules, and script execution capabilities on upload directories prevents adversaries from executing uploaded web shells.
mappings.environment_limitations: Requires web application server configuration review (e.g. disabling PHP execution in upload folders in nginx/Apache/IIS).
